name: Pork Chops au Poivre (Creamy Peppercorn Sauce)
why: Verified published nutrition 515 cal / 4g carbs / 31g protein per serving (4 servings) - dead center of the 400-650 cal band and near the floor on carbs. Classic French au poivre treatment: pork chops pan-seared then simmered in a brandy-beef-cream peppercorn pan sauce - meat + fat, no rice/potato/pasta/bread base, structurally low-carb and it batches cleanly to 14 in a skillet with weigh-and-divide portioning. Distinct signature (creamy brandy peppercorn SAUCE) versus the existing candidate peppercorn-crusted-pork-rib-chops, which is a dry cracked-pepper CRUST with no cream sauce - adjudicator should confirm that distinction. PRICER-LANE FLAGS: brandy has no obvious board home (a splash of cooking brandy per batch) and shallot may need to map to onion or be added as a new commodity; heavy cream, butter, beef broth, pork chop all have board homes. Left in deliberately per the invert-the-shakedown instruction so the pricer queue gets exercised.
